cast.role: the Elephant's Child's tall aunt

cast.name: the Hippopotamus

cast.description: A Primitive man in a cave, in a few clothes, taller than Taffy, who spears carp with a shark's-tooth spear and mends it with deer-sinews, bee's-wax and resin. Manner: patient, unhurried, embarrassed.

cast.name: Taffy (Taffimai Metallumai)
cast.role: the little girl daughter who ought to be spanked
cast.description: A small child with little fat legs who lies on her tummy with her legs in the air to draw, and stamps her foot at strangers. Manner: commanding, matter-of-fact, cheerful.

cast.name: the Stranger-man of the Tewara tribe
cast.role: the stranger of the far Tewara tribe who understands no word of the family's language
cast.description: A polite stranger man wearing a bead and seed and shark's-tooth necklace, standing taller than the little girl; his legs get scratched by brambles as he runs. Manner: polite, alarmed, patient under provocation.

cast.name: the Neolithic ladies
cast.role: the six Neolithic ladies of the Primitive lunch who sit on the Stranger-man
cast.description: A crowd of Neolithic women of about Teshumai's height who sit in a long line of six on the Stranger-man and fill his hair with mud; afterwards they call him Idiot. Manner: shocked, genteelly ferocious.

locations.name: the bank of the Wagai river
locations.description: The shallow carp-fishing river where Tegumai mends his broken spear while Taffy draws on a flat piece of birch-bark; later the whole Tribe stands on the bank demanding an explanation.

text.speaker: c_cat

cast.name: the Cat
cast.role: the wildest of the wild animals, who walks by himself
cast.description: A small wild cat, smaller than the Dog and much smaller than the Man, grey and thin, who comes to the cave only when nobody else will take him and insists to the last that all places are alike to him. Manner: conceited, calculating, appreciative.

cast.name: the Dog (the First Friend)
cast.role: the wild Dog who became the First Friend of the Cave
cast.description: A dog of medium size, wild at first, who lifts his nose to smell the roast mutton and is the first wild thing to come to the cave; later he guards it at night. Manner: eager, faithful, bared teeth.

cast.name: the Wild Horse (the First Servant)
cast.role: the wild Horse who became the First Servant
cast.description: A tall wild horse, much larger than the Cat and the Dog, who trips and stumbles on his long mane and takes the plaited hide halter; he carries the family from place to place. Manner: willing, heavy, proud.

locations.name: the Wet Wild Woods
locations.description: A wet primeval forest where all the wild animals live by their wild lones; the Cat's place, and where he hides to listen and later runs up a tree.

Emerson

text.text: To believe your own thought, to believe that what is true for you in your private heart is true for all men,...

cast.description: The speaking writer of the essay; he argues from his own heart and records his honest thought day by day. Usually shown at a writing desk by a window with roses below, pen and paper before him, a plain dark coat or scholar's gown, no hat.

cast.name: Society
cast.role: the custom, conformity and joint-stock company Emerson argues against
cast.description: Metaphor: the pressure of custom, names, badges and dead institutions that Emerson treats as a single conspiring force; drawn as an official-looking, respectable pressure that closes over an individual. Metaphor: the collective that trades away its members' liberty and culture for bread.

locations.name: The Field of Argument
locations.description: A plain open ground used for the essay's reasoning, where single figures stand against a shifting field of custom, numbers and borrowed light.

spec.purpose: Emerson names the unsaid highest truth: good arrives wholly strange, excluding example, life only avails rather than the having lived, and power lives only in the moment of transition.

panels.beat: Emerson in the open field, one hand lifted, declaring that when good is near it comes by no accustomed way

text.speaker: c_emerson
text.text: When good is near you, it comes by no known or accustomed way.

text.speaker: c_emerson
text.text: The good shall be wholly strange and new. It shall exclude example and experience.
